question: If (sin theta-cos theta)/(sin theta+cos theta)=(4)/(5), then the value of (cosec²theta)/(2-cosec²theta) is:
solution:
**Given:**

(sin θ-cos θ)/(sin θ+cos θ)=(4)/(5)

**Concept used:**

By componendo & dividendo rule:

⇒ (a + b)/(a - b) = p/q

⇒ a/b = (p + q)/(p - q)

By Pythagorean theorem:

H2 = P2 + B2

Where P = perpendicular ; B = base

and H = hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

(sin θ + cos θ)/(sin θ - cos θ) = 5/4

By componendo & dividendo rule:

⇒ Sin θ/cos θ = (5 + 4)/(5 - 4)

⇒ Tan θ = 9

Here, P = 9 & B = 1

By Pythagorean theorem:

H² = P² + B²

⇒ H = √(9² + 1) 

⇒ H = √82

(cosec²theta)/(2-cosec²theta)

⇒ (√82/9)²/{2 - (√82/9)2}

⇒ (82/81)/{2 - 82/81}

⇒ (82/81)/{(162 - 82)/81}

⇒ (82/81)/{(80/81}

⇒ 82/80 = (41)/(40)

**∴ The correct answer is (41)/(40).**
